jobs.title: Power Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our Group Technology and Security team, delivering automation and workflow solutions that improve operational efficiency and enhance user experience across the organisation. Our team develops, supports, and continuously improves business-critical applications and integrations using Microsoft technologies. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, we drive innovation through automation, platform engineering, and AI-enabled capabilities.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play?

You will design, develop, support, and enhance business-critical automation and workflow solutions using Microsoft Power Platform and related technologies. Working across Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, and enterprise integrations, you will build scalable solutions that streamline business processes and improve operational outcomes. You will also develop and maintain custom connectors, API integrations, and automation workflows that support key business functions.

In addition to solution delivery, you will provide Level 3 production support for critical applications and automations, investigating and resolving complex platform, integration, and application issues. You will support release management, testing, and change activities across development and production environments while identifying opportunities to improve platform reliability, governance, and user experience. You will also contribute to AI Builder initiatives, platform standards, and continuous improvement efforts to ensure stable and secure operations.

What You Offer

3+ years of experience developing, supporting, or enhancing Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps and Power Automate
Strong experience with SharePoint Online, enterprise workflow automation, and business process optimisation
Hands-on experience developing integrations using REST APIs, JSON, custom connectors, and related integration technologies
Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and production support experience within enterprise environments
Experience supporting testing, deployment, release management, platform governance, and continuous improvement initiatives
Exposure to AI Builder, Power Platform ALM, Power BI, ServiceNow, Coupa, Python, or other enterprise platforms and automation technologies is an advantage.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

Benefits

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:

1 wellbeing leave day per year
20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
5 days carers leave of immediate family members on top of annual leave
2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
Voluntary parental medical insurance plan for married employees
Wellbeing benefits, sessions and events to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing, including a comprehensive medical and life insurance cover
Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
Reimbursement for work from home equipment

About Technology

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.

Inclusion at Macquarie

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.

We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

jobs.title: Sr Systems Developer (DevOps Engineer)
jobs.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Thermo Fisher Scientific is seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer
to join our technology team. In this role, you will contribute to the analysis, design, development, testing, and ongoing support of moderately complex technical systems. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to implement and evolve DevOps practices, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure and delivery pipelines.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys automation, system optimization, and driving operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions
Lead containerization initiatives using Docker and Podman
Perform Red Hat Linux server maintenance, upgrades, and migrations
Set up, maintain, and optimize Redis servers
Install, configure, and maintain Jenkins environments
Manage SSL/TLS certificates and ensure secure communication standards
Maintain and migrate virtual machine environments
Automate infrastructure and operational tasks using Python, Bash, and PowerShell
Collaborate with development and operations teams to embed DevOps best practices
Support incident response, root cause analysis, and release management activities

Required Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience with relevant formal academic or vocational qualifications
Minimum 5 years of experience in systems development, DevOps, or a related role

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong proficiency with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub)
Hands-on experience with scripting and automation (Python, Bash)
Solid experience with container technologies (Docker, Podman)
Knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and observability tools and strategies
Familiarity with Agile methodologies, Git workflows, and enterprise compliance standards
Experience integrating vulnerability scanning and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and HIPAA
Working knowledge of Azure and AWS cloud platforms
Strong understanding of cloud and infrastructure security best practices
Ability to design proactive alerting and observability solutions
Proven ability to mentor junior engineers and promote DevOps best practices
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders
Analytical, detail-oriented, and strong problem-solving mindset

Must-Have Skills

CI/CD pipeline development using Jenkins
Scripting and automation using Python and Bash
Containerization with Docker and Podman
Experience with monitoring and alerting systems

jobs.description:
Find endless opportunities to solve our clients' toughest challenges, as you work with exceptional people, the latest tech and leading companies across industries.

Practice:
Industry X.O, Industry Consulting

Areas of Work:
Product Platforms, Platform Architecture/Engineering

L
ocation:
Uptown Tower 3, BGC, Taguig City (Manila, Philippines)

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Are you an outcome-oriented problem solver? Do you enjoy working on transformation strategies for global clients? Does working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest?

Then, Accenture Strategy and Consulting
is the right place for you to explore limitless possibilities.

We are looking for seasoned consultant with exceptional skills in product platforms, platform architecture & engineering excellence to help our client achieve their business plan, create new business models for their platforms & drive the right kind of engineering innovation required for success.

Products & Platforms Engineering and Modernization will need to work closely with leadership to define and deliver consulting services in the areas of Digital Product Management, Platform Engineering & Agile Excellence.

Prior experience in Software Product Management, Engineering Management and Platform Architecture is desired. Track record of delivering large scale transformations internally or as a service provider is huge plus.

Prefer candidates who have worked in Management/Technology consulting & engineering services background.

Consultant:

5+ years of experience in Consulting, Product/Software Platforms, Platform Architecture/Design.

Experience of working in Technology Product Management, Software Engineering, Software Architecture, Solution Design & Engineering Delivery Management.

Ability to work in Global Environment using Onshore Offshore model.

Proven track record of delivering high-impact, high-visibility engagements for large Communications & Media, Software Platforms, High Tech, or Engineering clients.

Experience in contribution to large-scale digital transformation or digital/software product management experience (b2b or b2c) as part of the core/scale team is preferred.

Worked in Management/Technology consulting & engineering services background.

As a Consultant, you will be responsible for:

Delivering high-impact client solutions by bringing together offerings with a clear understanding of the client problem statement.

Supporting the development of offerings, material, tools in Platform Engineering, Product Management & Platform Data Management.

Owning and managing key stakeholder relationships with the account team as per deployment in the areas of Platform Engineering.

Developing personal capability in areas of Product Management, Agile Engineering, Data Platforms & Delivery.

Supporting executives in growing the consulting business.

Contributing positively to the leadership group of Product & Platform Engineering.

Manager/Senior Manager:

10+ years (for Manager) or 15+ years (for Senior Manager) of total experience

8+ years of experience in Consulting, Product/Software Platforms, Platform Architecture/Design

Experience of working in Technology Product Management, Software Engineering, Software Architecture, Solution Design & Engineering Delivery Management.

Ability to work in Global Environment using Onshore Offshore model

Proven track record of delivering high-impact, high-visibility engagements for large Communications & Media, Software Platforms, High Tech or Engineering clients.

Experience in contribution to large-scale digital transformation or digital/software product management experience (b2b or b2c) as part of the core/scale team is preferred.

Worked in Management/Technology consulting & engineering services background.

As a Manager/Senior Manager, you will be responsible for:

Leading Product & Platform Engineering transformation solution development to drive growth for Accenture’s clients.

Build & curate offerings, material, tools in Platform Engineering transformation, Product Management, Process Excellence, Cybersecurity & AI/GenAI and Data Management.

Design & execute measurable go-to-market activities & initiatives aligned with the objectives of the business group in transformation (i.e. SAP SD, data migration, SAP4hana and ServiceNow and AI).

Own & manage key stakeholder relationships with global offering leaders in the areas of Platform Engineering.

Building the capability of the team in areas of Product Management, Agile Engineering, Data Platforms & Delivery and Change Management.

Delivering high-impact client solutions by bringing together offerings with a clear understanding of the client problem statement.

Owning & growing the consulting business in areas mentioned above.

Contributing positively to the leadership group of Product & Platform Engineering.

What’s in it for you?

An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients.

Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.

Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities.

Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

About Accenture:

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 624,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
.

About Accenture Strategy & Consulting:

In Accenture Strategy & Consulting, we work with clients to shape their future. Drawing from years of leading business-driven and tech-enabled transformation at scale. As a recognized leader in driving change and innovation, serving clients in 120+ countries - we’re able to seek out and seize the greatest opportunities for our clients. Working in partnership with over 200 of the world’s leading ecosystem partners, we can re-tool traditional ways of working to enable new enterprise-wide intelligence and adaptability. Start your journey with us and be part of our global network of world-class Strategy and Management Consulting Talent today. To learn more about S&C, visit accenture.com/strategyandconsultingph
.
